entries.question: What scholarships are available at Plaksha?
entries.answer:
Plaksha University offers several scholarship and financial aid options for deserving students:

• **Merit Scholarships**: Tuition waivers ranging from 25% to 100% based on high academic performance (typically 95%+ in boards or 95%ile+ in JEE) and extracurricular achievements.
• **Need-Based Financial Aid**: Available to students with a gross annual family income below INR 50 lakh, providing waivers from 25% to 100% depending on specific income slabs.
• **Bharti Scholarship**: A prestigious program that fully supports up to 20 undergraduate students who demonstrate both merit and financial need.
• **PhD Fellowships**: Monthly stipends ranging from ₹42,000 to ₹48,000, with special fellowships for Computer Science and AI starting at ₹80,000 and rising to ₹1,00,000 by the fifth year.
• **SP Dutt Award**: An award available to students as part of the university's recognition programs.

entries.question: What is the average placement package at Plaksha?
entries.answer:
The average placement package (CTC) at Plaksha University for the B.Tech Class of 2025 is ₹20 lakh per annum. Other key placement statistics include:
• Median CTC: ₹17 lakh per annum
• Highest CTC: ₹65 lakh per annum
• Top 25% Average: ₹34 lakh per annum
• Top 10% Average: ₹48 lakh per annum

entries.question: When was Plaksha University founded?
entries.answer: Plaksha University was established in 2021, with the campus opening its doors in August of that year. The journey began in 2015 as a conversation among friends, followed by the formation of the Reimagining Higher Education Foundation in 2017 and the groundbreaking of the Mohali campus in February 2019.

entries.question: What BTech programs does Plaksha University offer?
entries.answer:
Plaksha University offers four interdisciplinary BTech degrees:
• BTech in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence
• BTech in Robotics & Autonomous Systems (also referred to as Robotics & Cyber-Physical Systems)
• BTech in Biological Systems Engineering
• BTech in Data Science, Economics & Business

The curriculum is designed to be flexible, allowing students to explore different majors during their first three semesters before officially declaring their choice.

entries.question: How much is the annual tuition fee at Plaksha?
entries.answer:
Annual tuition fees at Plaksha University vary by program and intake year:
• **BTech (Aug 2026 intake):** ₹8,40,000 per year.
• **BTech (2025 intake):** ₹7.8 lakh per year.
• **PhD:** ₹5,000 per semester (this is a nominal fee after a 95% tuition waiver provided for teaching assistance).

For BTech students, the actual amount paid may be lower as approximately 67% of students receive financial aid or scholarships ranging from 25% to 100% waivers. Fees are also subject to an annual revision of 5% to 8%.
